statements.notes: Directions: Adults take 2 capsules daily as a dietary supplement, preferably before 4pm with empty stomach and plenty of water.

Avoid to use it before go to sleep.
Caution: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult your healthcare professional before use if you are a person with known medical condition.
Store in a cool & dry place. Keep bottle tightly closed.

Do not use if you are under 18 years old, pregnant or breastfeeding.
Keep out of reach of children
